Each type evolves identically; multiplicities truncated at 0/1/2 preserve all neighbor-color existence predicates for each type, including self-exclusion when two same-type shores are needed. All 3^7−36=2151 admissible truncated profiles can therefore represent every multipartite graph with >=3 shores, so exhaustive F^5=F^2 verification on the reduced finite state space is a genuine all-size proof, not an extrapolation from bounded shore sizes. Independently implemented support evolution reproduced equality F5=F2 for all 2151 cases, and the full 343 support triple classification histogram (0,1):3,(0,3):121,(1,1):66,(1,3):90,(2,1):27,(2,3):36. The rainbow transversal absence Hall criterion and the prior irrotationality synchronization theorem derive exact consensus basin B(a,b,c); independent support occupancy summation matched it for (1,1,2),(2,2,2),(2,3,4),(3,4,5). Weighting support size k by surjective coloring numbers 1,2^n−2,3^n−3·2^n+3 gives the source polynomial P of immediately periodic 3-cycle configurations, divided by three for orbits; the finite complete 343-support certificate controls all sizes. All fixed states are monochrome; time-two sharp witness verified. Balanced asymptotics follow from degree-leading support weights.
